finding.title: Response envelopes confirmed from the inventory
finding.body: books, searchBooks and orders read the payload under 'data' (the one array root property beside meta / nextCursor); every single-record operation reads the whole body (envelope null); cancelOrder is a 204 with no body. The envelope names the wrapper key only; flatten-or-keep is the pagination decisions D-oqs0jf and D-qf95m2.
